runtime: macOS host CPython 3.14.5; Python standard library only
container: Not required by this finite deterministic scorer; no container used
preconditions: Candidate and auditor source plus fixture, truth, protocol, wrappers, and construction history committed on the additive A02 branch
Issue preregistration posted before either formal command
Every frozen input/source hash verified immediately before invocation

decision_rules.pass: PASS_METHOD_SCOPED only if common checks and all budgets match, structured invalid proposals are fewer than both controls, all changed-envelope controls reopen, recall is no lower than either control, independent audit has zero errors, and all five mutations are rejected
decision_rules.fail: FAIL_METHOD for audit errors/missed mutations; FAIL_NEGATIVE_SUPPRESSION if a changed-envelope positive is not proposed
decision_rules.hold: HOLD_VERIFIER_ACCESS_MISMATCH for any cross-arm verifier, exposure, lookup, review-slot, or context-budget mismatch
decision_rules.no_incremental_value: NO_INCREMENTAL_VALUE if integrity gates pass but the preregistered comparative advantage is absent

scope: Finite hand-authored deterministic method fixture only; no inference about human cognition, real-agent behavior, open-literature discovery, scientific validity, or product benefit
